scope: Isolated compatibility worktree only; new canonical public read adapter and its real local PostgreSQL tests.
implemented: All five modern browsing methods use the selected shared native or verified rollback browse interface, never operational public tournament, chain_event or credit projections.

Source selection is checked before, inside one repeatable-read read-only private transaction with the shared source fence, and after; a second fixed-anchor canonical browse must agree before returning.
Opaque keyset cursors bind deployment, source release, source identity, selected epoch/kind/identity, filter and canonical block/hash anchor. Changed or expired canonical witnesses fail closed.
Private submitted-seat markers require canonical roster wallet, seat, incarnation and, after freeze, the matching canonical strategy commitment.
Fighter display requires the canonical NFT/chain/incarnation and a verified saved snapshot checksum.
Video-ready display requires the matching canonical input/result/incarnation, actual frozen-event ID/hash, revealed input, valid adjudication and validated immutable publication.
Island totals and page rows share one canonical browse snapshot; wallet summaries and reward ledger retain distinct credits, payouts, refunds and aggregate withdrawals.

cases: Real native browse SQL/runtime/checkpoint/source manifest, keyset pages, wallet totals, reward ledger, timeline and island history ignore contradictory legacy rows.
Correct private wallet/NFT joins and checksum validation; valid same-ID canonical reopening cannot inherit old private submissions or fighter snapshots.
Matching canonical freeze/publication enables video-ready; changed freeze witness disables it; mismatched post-freeze private commitments do not appear submitted.
Changed cursor anchors, stale source readiness and partially indexed native writes refuse without fallback.
Canonical source/ABI evidence corruption and operational source-mode changes refuse without fallback.

validation.formatting: Both new files formatted with the retained local Prettier; no dependency changes.

limits: The local fixture runs actual shared readArenaBrowse and readBoundRuntime SQL against native-shaped PostgreSQL relations and actual migrated operational private tables. Its source-status frame is deliberately injected and tested as ready/stale; it does not run Ponder synchronization or claim live-chain acceptance.
The summary ready flag validates the immutable publication identity and canonical data bindings; file availability/content checks remain the existing media status/artifact reader responsibility.
No production deployment, migration, provider call, wallet transaction or Git operation was performed.
